label: First mover necessity controls checked (inference)
rule: General laws and explicit finite models
meaning: Premise-free laws relating B6 to its necessity form, B4 to its converse-direction halves, route B's pure-act lemma and the strength of the disjunctive bridge; then twelve finite models: an omission model for each non-logical premise of the routes, a nonvacuity model for all routes and both endpoints, and a two-root model. Model-witnessed separations only; no premise is established and no reality claim is made.
